name: agentarmy-event-bridge
description: AgentArmy HTTP↔NATS event-bus bridge — inbound webhook receiver (HMAC-verified, CloudEvents v1.0) and outbound NATS-to-HTTP relay (JetStream push-consumer + retry/DLQ). One image, two modes (serve-inbound / relay-outbound). Realizes ARC-ADR-022 on top of middle-core's NATS JetStream + CloudEvents broker choice (ARC-ADR-001 / PR #73).

shims.note: stdlib hmac.compare_digest is constant-time (secure-by-default); cryptography pulled for KV-resolved secrets; pydantic guards input shape; nats-py + JetStream auto-stream-create on boot.

baked.purpose: FastAPI inbound receiver: HMAC verify -> replay dedup -> CloudEvents v1.0 envelope -> JetStream publish (auto-creates FLEET stream on boot).
JetStream push-consumer that POSTs each event to SINK_URL; acks on 2xx, naks on non-2xx (JS redeliver -> DLQ in Phase 1). Emits the cross-cluster clock-skew SLI on each receive (ARC-ADR-038 §5).

Clock-skew SLI: parses the temporal-envelope HLC from each received CloudEvent and prints an NDJSON fleet.clock.skew_ms metric (ARC-ADR-038 §5, ARC-ADR-010). Stdlib-only; graceful no-op for events without an hlc.

doctor.description: /healthz 200; POST with wrong HMAC -> 401 (sieve holds); POST with good HMAC -> 202 + the same CloudEvent reads back from the JetStream FLEET stream (events flowing end-to-end).

deploy.notes: Receiver needs a public URL for inbound webhooks (Container Apps ingress); relay is internal. NATS lives in middle-core per ARC-ADR-001.

contract.note: Inbound HTTP surface (POST /webhooks/github + GET /healthz). Distinct from the broker-side contract (CloudEvents v1.0 over JetStream, registered as 'Event bus').
Outbound NATS→HTTP relay is governed by ARC-ADR-022; its sink endpoint is configured per-deployment (SINK_URL).
